# proxmox_guest_cloudinit (Resource)

Regenerates the QEMU cloud-init drive through `PUT /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/cloudinit`. The guest must be stopped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_cloudinit" "regen" {
  node     = "pve"
  vmid     = 100
  triggers = { revision = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
